verdict.rationale: Runway documents its own automated flows: Runway Ads automatically generates on-brand ads and publishes them to Meta, Google and TikTok, and Recipes provide prebuilt multi-step video and image workflows. However, nothing shows that users can configure their own automations, schedules or triggers that run unattended in the background. The async task API and model routing are developer building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: user-configurable automations, scheduling or event triggers, documentation of autonomous background execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.
